_about: The one-handed attack of examples/one_handed_attack.example.json after its weapon was swapped (docs/motions/one_handed_weapon_attack.md, 'Swapping the weapon'). The clip and its accepted blade path were made with the old sword in the old hold: `path_hold` is that old placement, and with it the old sword's `grip` and `tip`, so the new blade follows the old blade's line. The one_hand_weapon entry is the new sword in the hold and the fist the author posed by hand; swing_arm solves the arm for that hold. Frame 0 is shared with the idle: `pin` keeps the clip's arm there, `ease_frames` eases the path into the pinned frame's real sword pose, `other_arm_blend` brings the left arm to the idle's first frame at both ends.

phases.text: A person stands in a fighting stance with the left foot forward, then raises the right arm high above the right shoulder.
The person swings the right arm hard down and across the body to the left.
The person lowers the right arm and settles back into the fighting stance.
